## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The `make test` instruction in AGENTS.md is now stale and needs updating: the Makefile no longer has a `test` target, and the guide says these commands are the repository's only checks.

## Changes
The pull request renames the Makefile's `test` target to `check` and updates the README to match. It also adds a Layout section to AGENTS.md that lists each file and the Makefile targets.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- AGENTS.md:24 — comments — Change `make test` to `make check` in the Commands section — An agent that follows "Run `make test` before you push; it runs the pytest suite." will get a make error saying there is no rule for target `test`, because `Makefile:6` now defines only `check`. The new Layout line in the same file says "`Makefile` defines the `check` and `lint` targets", so the guide now contradicts itself. — Agents following the guide get a failing command, and AGENTS.md:26 says these commands are the only checks a change gets, so the suite may never run before a push.
